subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-owned configuration entry points as `configUrl`/`configButton`, a more general typed skill action contract, or defer this to ClawHub/Skill Card metadata?
rationale: The implementation shape is small-to-medium, but the permanent public metadata semantics and dashboard URL trust policy are product/security decisions rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Design a typed skill action contract
options.body: Add a general configuration/action model that can cover configure links now and future skill actions without creating one-off fields.

options.title: Accept the proposed two fields
options.body: Implement `configUrl` and `configButton` directly with a strict URL policy and documentation, trading speed for a narrower public API.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub or Skill Cards
options.body: Keep core `SKILL.md` metadata unchanged and require published skills to expose configuration entry points through registry or card metadata instead.

recommendation.title: Design a typed skill action contract
recommendation.body: Add a general configuration/action model that can cover configure links now and future skill actions without creating one-off fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The current skill metadata/parser/status payload history points to Vincent Koc as the best available owner for the core skill metadata side of the decision.
